C0455.title: Cracking Down on Bank Card Crimes: Ministry of Public Security Releases Eight Typical Cases
C0455.summary: In April 2023, the Economic Investigation Division of Beijing Chaoyang Sub-Bureau initiated investigations into three credit card fraud cases. Through in-depth analysis, a total of 35 credit card fraud cases with identical modus operandi were linked.
